highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, composable image filters, and faster CPU blurs.
highlights_body: New overdraw and paint-bounds helpers support rendering diagnostics and culling. Upgraders should replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs and account for the removed notebook integration.

breaking.title: Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs
breaking.body: Legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors with sampleCount, run-buffer accessors, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality now produce compile errors. Use constructors without sampleCount, Glyphs/Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. The enums leave the reference assembly but remain in the implementation for ABI compatibility. The two SKFont-based DrawText overloads without explicit alignment remain warning-only.

breaking.title: Notebook integration is no longer bundled
breaking.body: SkiaSharp no longer ships its .NET Interactive/Polyglot Notebooks extension after upstream deprecation. Notebook consumers must provide their own rendering integration rather than relying on automatic SkiaSharp formatters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while preserving Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor.
Includes upstream AAT and Arabic fallback shaping corrections, COLR v1 paint and clipping fixes, and more accurate glyph extents.

bullets.lead: Composable crop and empty image filters
bullets.detail: SKImageFilter.CreateCrop restricts filter output with a rectangle and tile mode. CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input.

bullets.lead: Overdraw visualization and conservative paint bounds
bullets.detail: SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a six-color palette. SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns conservative bounds for quick-reject culling, or false when they cannot be computed.
Restores the dedicated raster blur path for small-sigma 8888 images, avoiding the slower shader-based Gaussian path.
Corrects a race between opening and reusing a CoreText-backed typeface stream on Apple platforms.
SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper instead of repeating native lookups on every access. Explicitly disposing that wrapper still allows a subsequent access to obtain a usable wrapper.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the v4 deprecation pass, cached surface canvas wrappers, and restored the faster small-sigma raster blur path

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with Skia m150, retaining Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the remaining v4 deprecation pass, and removed the deprecated notebook integration.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added crop, empty, overdraw, and paint-bounds helpers, restored faster small-sigma CPU blurs, and reduced surface canvas lookup overhead.

harfbuzz_summary: The collected HarfBuzzSharp-specific work migrates its test suite to xUnit v3; that change does not alter shaping behavior or the binding API.

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.headline: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with Skia m150.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.headline: Preview 2 updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the pre-v4 deprecation pass, and retired notebook integration.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.headline: The release candidate added crop and empty image filters, paint bounds and overdraw diagnostics, and restored CPU blur performance.

v4.150.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 promotes the release candidate to stable without additional collected changes.
